snippet.title: Harry Potter and The Chamber of Secrets | Xbox + 16:9 | Longplay Full Game Walkthrough No Commentary
snippet.description:
Full game longplay of Harry Potter and The Chamber of Secrets, a game adaption of the second movie movie in the Harry Potter anthology. It was released in 2002 on all the consoles, from GBA to PS2, GCN and Xbox. This here is the Xbox version. Note that this game released BEFORE the PS2/Xbox/GCN versions of Philosopher's Stone, those specific versions of PS were released after Chamber of Secrets, as initially there were only then-last-gen versions. 

Recorded at 1440p and 30 fps only, BUT the game run at a very good 60 fps internally, it's just my mistake, I did not set OBS back up to 60 fps recording, apologies. AND, I've also used a widescreen hack here, which works much better than the Philosopher's Stone one did. Played internally at 480p, 16x9 due to the aformentioned hack.

My own GOG refflink, it helps out the channel directly: https://adtr.co/n6h4w4

Note: I've already got the Xbox version of Philosopher's/Sorcerer's Stone recorded and published on my channel.

The game's core gameplay is straightforward. Taking control of Harry, the player explores Hogwarts castle and grounds. Throughout the course of the game, the player will encounter events that tie into the storyline of the second book. Filling the gaps between these events are various classes, where the player will learn how to fly a broomstick and learn new spells for combating bosses, among other things. Each new spell is accompanied by a challenge, which the player must get through in a certain amount of time to complete that class period. During the later parts of the game, the player will face challenges which are not time-limited and are not related to learning spells. These challenges are all based on events from the book, for example, travelling into the Forbidden Forest and gathering ingredients for a potion Hermione is making.

=============================================================================================
